title: Technology Sector Update for 06/27/2018: BIDU,DTRM,IGT
text:
CSCO -0.10%
GOOG -0.18%
Technology stocks were mostly lower Wednesday although Apple ( AAPL ) was scratching out a small gain in pre-market trading .
Among technology stocks moving on news:
+ Baidu ( BIDU ) was higher in Wednesday's early session, rising almost 1%, after the Chinese-language search engine company authorized a $1 billion stock buyback program that will be implemented over the next 12 months. The company plans to fund repurchases from its existing cash balance.
In other sector news:
- Determine ( DTRM ) retreated in Tuesday after-hours trading, falling almost 9%, after the software-as-a-service company reported a wider-than-expected Q4 net loss and revenue that fell short of analyst forecasts. Net loss during the three months ended March 31 tripled year-over-year to $0.12 per share compared with its $0.04 per share loss during the first three months in 2017 and missing the Capital IQ consensus expecting a $0.10 per share net loss. Revenue fell to $6.8 million from $7.5 million during the same period last year, lagging the $7.3 million Street view.
- International Game Technology ( IGT ) late Tuesday said it has secured a multi-product systems and games agreement with the Ocean Resort Casino opening soon in Atlantic City, N.J. The new contract calls on International Game Tech to install its IGT Advantage casino management system and connecting over 1,900 slot machine games. The company also will leverage its Remote Game Server system to deliver games to desktop computers and mobile devices.
